description_en: Removes one or more ECS instances from a scaling group
description_zh: 从一个伸缩组移出一台或多台ECS实例
name: DetachInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to modify the expected number of instances. Valid values:

true: After the ECS instances, ECI instances, or managed instances are removed from the scaling group, the expected number of instances is decreased by the corresponding number.
false: After the ECS instances, ECI instances, or managed instances are removed from the scaling group, the expected number of instances remains unchanged.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否修改期望实例数。取值范围：

true：ECS实例或ECI实例移出伸缩组后，期望实例数也减少相应数量。
false：ECS实例或ECI实例移出伸缩组后，期望实例数不会变化。

默认值：true
parameters.name: decrease_desired_capacity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore invalid instances when removing a batch of instances from the scaling group. Valid values:

true: Invalid instances are ignored when a batch of instances is removed from the scaling group.

  If invalid instances exist in the batch (for example, the instance status is `Adding`) and the valid instances are successfully removed, the execution status of the scaling activity is displayed as `Warning`. You can view the invalid instances in the scaling activity details.
false: Invalid instances are not ignored when a batch of instances is removed from the scaling group.

  If invalid instances exist in the batch (for example, the instance status is `Adding`), an error is returned.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
从伸缩组移出一批实例时，是否忽略其中无效实例。取值范围：

true：从伸缩组中移出一批实例时会忽略其中的无效实例。

  如果一批实例中存在无效实例（例如实例状态为`加入中`），并且有效的实例被成功移出时，则伸缩活动执行状态显示为`警告`状态，您可以从伸缩活动详情查看无效的实例。
false：从伸缩组中移出一批实例时不会忽略无效实例。

  如果一批实例中存在无效实例（例如实例状态为`加入中`），则返回结果会报错。

默认值：false
parameters.name: ignore_invalid_instance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to stop using the ECS instances or ECI instances as backend servers of the load balancing instances (that is, remove the ECS instances or ECI instances from the default server group and virtual server group of the load balancing instances), and whether to remove the ECS instances or ECI instances from the access whitelists of the ApsaraDB RDS instances.

Valid values:

both: Removes the ECS instances or ECI instances from the default server group and virtual server group of the load balancing instances, and removes the ECS instances or ECI instances from the access whitelists of the ApsaraDB RDS instances.

Settings for this parameter are not supported when managed instances are removed from the scaling group
parameters.help_zh:
指定是否停止使用ECS实例或ECI实例作为负载均衡实例的后端服务器（即将ECS实例或ECI实例移出负载均衡实例的默认服务器组和虚拟服务器组），以及是否将ECS实例或ECI实例移出RDS实例的访问白名单。

both：将ECS实例或ECI实例移出负载均衡实例的默认服务器组和虚拟服务器组，并将ECS实例或ECI实例移出RDS实例的访问白名单
parameters.name: detach_option

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECS instances, ECI instances, or managed instances to be removed
parameters.help_zh:
待移出ECS实例或ECI实例的ID。N的取值范围：1~20。
举例如下所示：

待移出的ECS实例ID为`i-bp109k5j3dum1ce6****`。
待移出的ECI实例ID为`eci-bp17gw49eu09yiwm****`
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to trigger the scale-in lifecycle hook when ECS instances or ECI instances are removed from the scaling group. Valid values:
true: Triggers the hook.
false: Does not trigger the hook.
This parameter is not supported when managed instances are removed from the scaling group.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组移出ECS实例或ECI实例时，是否触发缩容生命周期挂钩。取值范围：
true：触发。
false：不触发。

默认值：false
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token
